sections.extract: NONABELIAN MULTIPLICATIVE INTEGRATION ON SURFACES AMNON YEKUTIELI Abstract. We construct a 2-dimensional twisted nonabelian multiplicative integral. sections.title: Multiplicative Integration in Dimension One
sections.extract: \label{sec:dim1} Nonabelian multiplicative integration in dimension $1$ is classical, dating back to work of Volterra (cf.\ \cite{DF}). In modern differential geometry it is usually viewed as the holonomy of a connection along a path.
